Priya (CSOps): FYI - healthscore recalc batch that ran at 02:00 UTC flagged a weird regression: ~62 accounts moved to "high renewal risk" but nothing in CRM changed. looks automated.
Alex (Data): can you paste the job id/logs? might be the owner-aggregation join from earlier this week.
Priya (CSOps): job snippet from logs: ```
2026-03-24T02:00:03Z job=healthscore-recalc run_id=hs-20260324-02 started
2026-03-24T02:10:12Z warn: account=AC-99877 owner_id=null merged_contact=true
2026-03-24T02:10:12Z result: health_score=42 -> 18 delta=-24 reason="no-owner-override"
```
Alex (Data): that "merged_contact=true" flag was part of the CRM dedupe migration on Mar 22; we set owner_id to null for contacts that were merged and plan to re-assign later. the healthscore join expects owner_id NOT NULL and treats null as "no active engagement" which lowers score.
Nora (CSM): so accounts whose owners were temporarily nulled got penalized? that's bad for renewal reporting. how many affected?
Alex (Data): quick query: ```sql
select count(distinct account_id) from accounts a
join events e on e.account_id=a.account_id and e.type='health_recalc' and e.ts >= '2026-03-24'
where a.owner_id is null and a.last_contacted >= now() - interval '90 days';
-- returns 62
```
Priya (CSOps): propose emergency patch: health_recalc should use last_known_owner or fallback to engagement flags instead of treating null as immediate penalty. we need a backward-compatible fallback.
Liam (SRE): low risk to apply a logical fallback in the scoring microservice config. we should do a staged deploy + synthetic test. i'll prepare a canary.
Alex (Data): fallback logic (pseudocode): ```python
def owner_effective(account):
  if account.owner_id is not None: return account.owner_id
  if account.meta.last_known_owner_id is not None: return account.meta.last_known_owner_id
  return 'fallback-engagement'  # uses recent_activity score instead of owner engagement
```
Priya (CSOps): action plan: 1) patch scoring service to use fallback, 2) re-run healthscore recalc for affected accounts (72h window), 3) add monitoring alert for sudden uplift in risk by >0.5% in 1h. owners: Alex-> patch & backfill query, Liam-> deploy canary, Priya-> monitor & notify CSMs. target: within 4 hours.
HealthJobBot: scheduled canary deploy for scoring-service at 2026-03-24T06:15:00Z (canary_id=can-441) :gear:
Alex (Data): pushing code change to staging now. adding unit test to verify owner fallback uses last_known_owner meta.
Nora (CSM): can you also export a CSV of the 62 accounts? i'll proactively email impacted AMs.
Alex (Data): CSV ready: 62 rows, s3://redwood-cs/incident/2026-03-24/owner-null-62.csv
Priya (CSOps): re-run query to mark backfill candidates: ```sql
select account_id from accounts where owner_id is null and last_onboarded >= now() - interval '90 days' and health_score < 30;
```
Liam (SRE): canary deployed to 3 nodes. running synthetic healthscore tests against sample accounts. no errors so far.
HealthJobBot: canary run completed successfully (canary_id=can-441) :white_check_mark:
Alex (Data): running backfill for 62 accounts now with a safety flag so we only overwrite scores if delta > 10 and source != 'manual'. backfill results: 60 updated, 2 skipped (manual override present).
Priya (CSOps): verified updates in dashboard: 60 moved back to prior bucket, historical charts updated. great. Nora - your CSV and note to AMs?
Nora (CSM): emailing AMs now with subject "Potential temporary healthscore dip for accounts (resolved)" and attaching CSV + explanation. adding CS outreach tasks for the 2 manual-overridden accounts.
Priya (CSOps): retro items: - add integration test that simulates CRM dedupe flags and ensures scoring fallback - add alert: "owner-null healthscore delta > 10 for >50 accounts in 1h" - schedule CR to change CRM migration to populate last_known_owner meta on merge. assigning Alex/Liam for tests + ticket.
Alex (Data): created ticket #CS-8473: "scoring-owner-fallback + tests" and PR linked.
Liam (SRE): I'll add the alert to the ops pager policy but set escalation to pages only if >200 accounts to avoid noise.
Priya (CSOps): final note: as of 2026-03-24T10:00Z affected accounts resolved; closing thread but leaving runbook update link in #cs-ops-docs. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
